description: Phase 4 MerLin adaptation of E2 (not the paper's method): photonic QNN (4 families: non-hybrid/hybrid x SQ'/MQ' readout) on m = 7 modes, n in {2, 3} photons, L in {1, 2} re-uploads between trainable MZI meshes, UNBUNCHED probabilities; paired with the Phase 3 ANN grid. Same data, folds, training and selection as e2_original.
